parsed.explanation: Tier-1 universal exposures dominate: the parent regime's facility bans in government buildings apply alongside the division's own enacted facility ban, the school birth-certificate restroom rule binds visitors on school grounds, and the national document regime (X markers ended, M/F only, reported passport blocking) reaches every crossing. The division adds its own hostile layer — it uniquely repealed gender-identity civil-rights protection and barred stronger local ordinances, leaving an outed visitor no state remedy for service refusal — placing it below its parent's line. Mitigating: no adult presentation offence documented here, no documented violence campaign or organised targeting (violence figures are explicitly undercount floors and position unknown), national employment protection and hate-crime statute persist, and enforcement of the school rule against adult visitors is undocumented. No criminalisation of identity, but unremedied exclusion plus official hostility keeps it in Elevated/High Risk.
